searchText: hi, got a question about the `contributionSchema.json` (https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/apiSpec/contributionSchema.json) in GitHub, shouldn't `bls_signature` be accepting `G2Point` instead of `G1Point`? <Marcin> > <Marcin> we have signatures in G1, pubkeys in G2, using BLS_SIG_BLS12381G1_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_POP_ (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <Stefan Bratanov> hi, got a question about the `contributionSchema.json` (https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/apiSpec/contributionSchema.json) in GitHub, shouldn't `bls_signature` be accepting `G2Point` instead of `G1Point`?) thank, I got confused from https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/docs/cryptography/BLS.md#sign It states `Returns a signature which is of type bls.G2Point` <Marcin> > <Marcin> Yeah, looks like a typo, mind opening a PR to fix it? (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <Stefan Bratanov> [reply]: thank, I got confused from https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/docs/cryptography/BLS.md#sign It states `Returns a signature which is of type bls.G2Point`) Yup 🙂 done: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/pull/41 By the way, I have one more PR by the way which i raised few days ago: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/pull/40 <Marcin> ^ cc @CarlBeek <CarlBeek> Merged 40 & 41, thanks Stefan! Nice intro to KZG https://scroll.io/blog/kzg
